tools.name: search_photos
tools.title: Search photos
tools.description: Search photos using intersecting Library filters (paginated, default limit 100): filename, keywords, rating, capture date, camera, lens, ISO, focal length, flag, color label, edited status, file type and folder. Provide at least one filter to improve performance on large catalogs.

include_path.description: Include each photo file path (default false). Rows always include id, filename, rating and dateTimeOriginal.

camera.description: Exact camera name indexed by Lightroom

lens.description: Exact lens name indexed by Lightroom

focal_length.description: Exact focal length in millimeters (not the 35mm equivalent)

edited.description: Whether the photo has develop adjustments

file_type.description: Lightroom file format; camera raw formats use RAW

folder.description: Folder text, including parent folders shown in Lightroom's Folders panel (contains all words)

tools.name: get_selected_photos
tools.title: Get selected photos
tools.description: Get currently selected photos in Lightroom (or filmstrip if no selection). Paginated, default limit 100.

include_path.description: Include each photo file path (default false). Rows always include id, filename, rating and dateTimeOriginal.

tools.name: summarize_develop_settings
tools.title: Summarize develop settings
tools.description: Summarize numeric Develop settings by camera model and ISO (1-400, 401-1600, 1601-6400, 6401+, unknown). Select rating >= min_rating (default 4; 0=all); exported_only requires raw isExported true. Reads at most max_photos settings (default/max 200); export filtering batches flags for all rating matches. Returns count and SDK-key median/min/max per group, scanned/matched/truncated. Excludes crop, perspective, Temperature/Tint, nonfinite/nonnumeric/all-zero settings. Alphabetical keys fill 6000 characters/group; settings_omitted counts size exclusions. Read-only.

exported_only.description: Require an exported photo as well as the minimum rating

max_photos.description: Maximum photos whose Develop settings are read

tools.name: get_photo_metadata
tools.title: Get photo metadata
tools.description: Read 1-100 photos: keywords/nested keywordPaths, EXIF, title/caption/headline, GPS latitude/longitude/altitude, IPTC sublocation/city/stateProvince/country/isoCountryCode, copyright, accessibility alt_text/extended_description (LrC 13.2+, omitted empty/unsupported), and optional developSettings. IDs are catalog local. isVirtualCopy marks copies; optional virtualCopy contains masterPhotoId or master copyIds. Optional folder stack contains position (top=1), isCollapsed, topPhotoId and ordered memberIds. developSettings is absent by default; request sections: ["developSettings"] to read it. Empty sections omits it; duplicates are accepted. developSettings covers every set_develop_settings key: basic/tone/parametric curves use camelCase; hsl/lens/transform/crop/detail/effects/parametricSplits use SDK names; empty groups are omitted.

photo_id.description: One photo ID or file path; supply photo_id or photo_ids, never both

photo_ids.description: 1 to 100 photo IDs or file paths; returns photos in request order and missing identifiers separately. Repeated identifiers produce repeated entries.

sections.description: Optional metadata sections to include for each photo. Omitted or empty returns all standard metadata without developSettings. Duplicates are accepted.

tools.name: get_photo_preview
tools.title: Get photo preview
tools.description: Lightroom-rendered JPEG with Develop edits (raw supported). region crops the rendered frame after develop crop/rotation: normalized x/y/width/height, origin top-left, x right, y down. width/height/bytes are actual; requested_size is the source request. See size for cost/edge rules.

size.description: Minimum longest edge: cull requests 512 (about 900px on the tested raw), detail requests 1024 (about 1800px); numeric 64-2048, default 512. Lightroom returns its smallest cached preview meeting the edge, often larger. Over 3.5 MB or 2000px retries smaller. cull is for culling (about 650 tokens), detail for inspecting details (about 2.5k tokens): earlier Claude estimates, varying by image/model and repeated each turn in history.

region.description: Rectangle within the rendered preview, including its develop crop and displayed orientation. Pixel bounds round outward. Region calls request a larger source by dividing size by the longest normalized side, capped at 2048; requested_size reports that source request.

tools.name: get_photo_previews
tools.title: Get batch photo previews
tools.description: Get JPEG thumbnails for 1–20 photos in input order for culling. Maps requested_id/photo_id to 1-based image_index; errors have no image and do not fail the batch. Default size 256; max edge 2000px; total budget 8 MiB. After 20 s returns complete:false and remaining_ids to retry. Catalog unchanged.

photo_ids.description: Between 1 and 20 IDs or paths, in image order

tools.name: find_duplicate_groups
tools.title: Find duplicate groups
tools.description: Group near-duplicates/bursts from up to 100 IDs/paths using 64-bit dHash of current JPEG previews (minimum edge 64) and raw capture time. Every pair must meet inclusive time_window_seconds (default 5) and max_hamming_distance (default 10). Input-order groups omit singletons and repeated photos; IDs are resolved. Approximate similarity does not rank frames. photos gives raw capture_time in Lightroom seconds (second precision, no timezone normalization). No hash cache or catalog changes. At 25 s returns partial groups, complete=false, remaining_ids; preview/missing-time failures are unprocessed with reasons. Retry remaining IDs with originals to grow groups.

photo_ids.description: Between 1 and 100 IDs or paths

tools.name: get_photo_stats
tools.title: Get photo statistics
tools.description: Measure current rendered JPEG previews for up to 20 photos; result/error per input ID. histogram: 64 normalized Rec.709 luma bins (0-255, four levels/bin); mean_luminance same scale; shadow_fraction <=1, highlight_fraction >=254. sharpness: four-neighbor Laplacian variance after area resampling to 512px long edge (enlarges small previews); higher=sharper. These measure JPEG previews, not raw clipping/full-resolution focus. Catalog unchanged.

photo_ids.description: Between 1 and 20 photo IDs or file paths, in result order

tools.name: set_gps
tools.title: Set GPS
tools.description: Replace GPS coordinates in decimal degrees. Altitude stays unless altitude or clear_altitude is given. Returns success, updated and missing IDs.

photo_ids.description: Array of photo IDs or file paths

clear_altitude.description: Remove the photos' altitude (default false). Cannot be combined with altitude.

tools.name: set_location
tools.title: Set location
tools.description: Set IPTC location fields from get_photo_metadata; at least one is required. Omitted fields stay, empty strings clear. GPS stays (use set_gps). Returns success, updated, fields and missing IDs.

photo_ids.description: Array of photo IDs or file paths

sublocation.description: Sublocation: a venue, landmark or neighbourhood (e.g. 'Sydney Opera House')

tools.name: set_metadata
tools.title: Set metadata
tools.description: Set IPTC text from get_photo_metadata. Accessibility needs LrC 13.2+. At least one field; omitted fields stay, empty strings clear. Copyright status is unwritable. Returns success, updated, fields and missing IDs.

photo_ids.description: Array of photo IDs or file paths

copyright_info_url.description: Copyright info URL, e.g. a licensing page

tools.name: set_ai_metadata
tools.title: Set AI metadata
tools.description: Store an AI score and reason in private per-photo plug-in metadata in this catalog. Provide score, reason or both. Score is an integer from 0 to 100; reason is at most 1024 characters. Omitted fields stay unchanged; an empty string clears a field. Does not change IPTC, XMP, keywords, or export metadata.

photo_ids.description: Array of photo IDs or file paths

tools.name: get_ai_metadata
tools.title: Get AI metadata
tools.description: Read private per-photo AI scores and reasons in one batch (up to 1000 IDs or paths). Returns photos with photo_id, numeric score and reason; unset fields are omitted. Missing IDs are reported separately.

photo_ids.description: Array of photo IDs or file paths

tools.name: list_folders
tools.title: List folders
tools.description: List catalog folders in tree order as a paginated flat list of full paths, names and photo_count (direct photos only, excluding subfolders). Default limit 100.

tools.name: get_folder_photos
tools.title: Get folder photos
tools.description: List photos in a catalog folder by its full path from list_folders (paginated, default limit 100). Subfolders are excluded by default.

tools.name: list_collections
tools.title: List collections
tools.description: List all collections in Lightroom catalog (paginated, default limit 100)

tools.name: create_collection
tools.title: Create collection
tools.description: Create a collection; returns success and its path.

parent.description: Parent collection set path (optional), levels separated by ' / ' as in list_collections (e.g. 'Trips / 2026'). Missing sets are created; existing ones are reused, matching names ignoring case as Lightroom does. Omit it for a top-level collection; an empty level or a level with leading or trailing spaces or slashes is rejected.

tools.name: create_smart_collection
tools.title: Create smart collection
tools.description: Save intersecting search_photos filters as an auto-updating smart collection; at least one filter. Creates missing parent sets; rejects existing sibling names. Returns success and path.

parent.description: Parent collection set path, with levels separated by ' / ' (e.g. 'Trips / 2026')

camera.description: Exact camera name indexed by Lightroom

lens.description: Exact lens name indexed by Lightroom

focal_length.description: Exact focal length in millimeters (not the 35mm equivalent)

edited.description: Whether the photo has develop adjustments

file_type.description: Lightroom file format; camera raw formats use RAW

folder.description: Folder text, including parent folders shown in Lightroom's Folders panel (contains all words)

tools.name: add_to_collection
tools.title: Add to collection
tools.description: Add photos to a collection; returns success, added count and missing IDs.

collection_name.description: Collection path from list_collections, or a bare name. A listed path always picks that collection; a bare name of a nested collection must be unique.

photo_ids.description: Array of photo IDs or file paths

tools.name: get_collection_photos
tools.title: Get collection photos
tools.description: List the photos in a collection, regular or smart (paginated, default limit 100). Use a path from list_collections when names repeat; an ambiguous bare name is rejected.

include_path.description: Include each photo file path (default false). Rows always include id, filename, rating and dateTimeOriginal.

collection_name.description: Collection path from list_collections, or a bare name. A listed path always picks that collection; a bare name of a nested collection must be unique.

tools.name: remove_from_collection
tools.title: Remove from collection
tools.description: Remove photos from a regular collection; catalog and other memberships stay. Returns success, removed (unique members), not_in_collection and missing IDs.

collection_name.description: Collection path from list_collections, or a bare name. A listed path always picks that collection; a bare name of a nested collection must be unique.

photo_ids.description: Array of photo IDs or file paths

tools.name: delete_collection
tools.title: Delete collection
tools.description: Delete a collection; photos stay in the catalog. Returns success, photo_count and that reminder.

collection_name.description: Collection path from list_collections, or a bare name. A listed path always picks that collection; a bare name of a nested collection must be unique.

tools.name: set_keywords
tools.title: Set keywords
tools.description: Add/remove keyword names or parent-first '|' paths from list_keywords, ignoring case. Missing names create top-level keywords; paths create missing levels unless create_missing=false. Returns success and updated count.

photo_ids.description: Array of photo IDs or file paths

add_keywords.description: Keywords to add: plain names or 'Parent|Child' hierarchy paths

remove_keywords.description: Keywords to remove: a plain name removes every keyword with that name, a 'Parent|Child' path removes only that one

create_missing.description: Default true. When false, nothing is created: every keyword to add must already exist, a plain name must match exactly one keyword anywhere in the hierarchy, and the call fails without changing anything if any keyword is unknown or ambiguous.

tools.name: remove_keyword_subtree
tools.title: Remove keyword subtree
tools.description: Detach a parent keyword and every descendant from photo_ids, or all tagged photos with catalog_wide=true. Matches paths ignoring case; unknown parent fails unchanged. Preserves unrelated and same-named keywords elsewhere. Keyword nodes stay in the catalog and list_keywords. Use a dedicated parent such as 'AI Keywords' with set_keywords to undo a tagging batch. Returns updated photo count, removed assignment count and missing IDs.

parent.description: Parent-first keyword path, for example 'AI Keywords' or 'Tags|AI Keywords'

photo_ids.description: Photos to detach the subtree from; omit when catalog_wide is true

catalog_wide.description: Explicitly detach the subtree from every photo in the catalog; cannot accompany photo_ids

tools.name: list_keywords
tools.title: List keywords
tools.description: List paginated parent-first keyword paths ('Places|Europe|Paris'), synonyms and include-on-export (limit default 100). Pass paths to set_keywords; narrow large trees with parent/query or request paths_only.

parent.description: Only list keywords below this keyword path (optional)

query.description: Only list keywords whose name or a synonym contains this text, ignoring case (optional)

paths_only.description: Return each keyword as just its path string instead of an object (default false)

tools.name: rename_keyword
tools.title: Rename keyword
tools.description: Rename in place; tagged photos update, parent/children/synonyms stay. Case-insensitive sibling conflicts fail; case-only renames work. Returns success, old_path, new_path and photo_count.

keyword.description: Keyword from list_keywords: a unique plain name or a 'Parent|Child' path

new_name.description: New name for that keyword (a single name, not a path)

tools.name: undo_last_step
tools.title: Undo last step
tools.description: Undo one shared Lightroom history step (confirm:true), including a user/other plug-in action after your edit. Ownership is unknown: call only if undoing the current last step is acceptable. Returns undone and can_undo for another undo.

confirm.description: Accept undoing the latest step in Lightroom's shared history

tools.name: set_rating_and_flag
tools.title: Set rating and flag
tools.description: Set rating, flag, or both in one write. Returns success, updated and missing; get_photo_metadata reports rating and pickStatus (pick 1, reject -1, none 0).

photo_ids.description: Array of photo IDs or file paths

rating.description: Star rating (0-5); supply rating, flag, or both

tools.name: set_color_label
tools.title: Set color label
tools.description: Set a color label or none to clear; get_photo_metadata reports colorLabel. Returns success, updated and missing IDs.

photo_ids.description: Array of photo IDs or file paths

label.description: Color name, or none to clear the label

tools.name: remove_photos_from_catalog
tools.title: Remove photos from catalog
tools.description: Remove up to 100 IDs/paths from catalog, losing catalog edits/metadata; files remain on disk (LrC 14.3+, confirm:true). Include every virtual copy with its master. Deduplicates; reports missing IDs. Opens Library grid/All Photographs, restores module/sources/surviving selection; Library stays in grid view.

photo_ids.description: Photo IDs or file paths to remove from the catalog

confirm.description: Explicit consent to lose these photos' catalog edits and metadata

tools.name: import_photos
tools.title: Import photos
tools.description: Import a photo or a folder recursively. Returns success, imported/skipped counts, skipped_by_extension, complete and remaining_paths. Only unsupported-extension notes remain in message.

source_path.description: Photo or folder to import. Folder imports accept camera raw (CR3, RAF, ORF, RW2, NEF, ARW, DNG and other Camera Raw formats), JPEG, HEIC/HEIF, AVIF, JPEG XL, TIFF, PNG and PSD/PSB; other files are skipped by extension.

collection_name.description: Collection to add imported photos to (optional)

tools.name: export_photos
tools.title: Export photos
tools.description: Export photos; returns success, exported count, destination, complete and remaining_ids to retry.

photo_ids.description: Array of photo IDs or file paths to export

destination.description: Absolute path of the export folder, created if missing; ~/ is expanded

on_existing.description: What to do when the destination already holds a file with that name (default rename). Lightroom never prompts.

tools.name: export_photo_metadata
tools.title: Export photo metadata
tools.description: Export up to 1000 photos to disk JSON: file/capture time/dimensions/rating/title/caption/GPS/location/keywords/keywordPaths, no develop settings. Omitted photo_ids uses selection, or filmstrip if none. Prefer over per-photo get_photo_metadata. Returns success, exported, destination and missing IDs.

photo_ids.description: Array of photo IDs or file paths (default: current selection)

destination.description: Absolute path of the .json file to write; ~/ is expanded

overwrite.description: Replace the file if it already exists (default false: fail instead)

tools.name: list_develop_presets
tools.title: List develop presets
tools.description: List Lightroom-visible Develop presets and plugin-managed checkpoints (paginated, default limit 100). Filter by name or folder before paging. Returns name, folder, scope and uuid; use get_develop_preset for backing-file metadata. count is the total matches; has_more indicates another page.

offset.description: Number of matching presets to skip (default 0; floored)

query.description: Keep presets whose name contains this text, ignoring case

folder.description: Exact, case-sensitive folder name, including Plugin Develop Presets for checkpoints

tools.name: get_develop_preset
tools.title: Get develop preset
tools.description: Read the settings and backing-file metadata for one exact Develop preset. Use preset_uuid or provide folder/scope when names are duplicated.

tools.name: compare_develop_presets
tools.title: Compare develop presets
tools.description: Compare two Develop presets and return a deterministic per-setting diff for iterative style matching

tools.name: create_develop_preset
tools.title: Create develop preset
tools.description: Capture selected settings as a versioned plugin Develop checkpoint, hidden from Develop; export for handoff. Returns success, preset identity/file, visible_in_develop:false and a checkpoint note.

photo_id.description: Source photo ID or file path

preset_name.description: Unique versioned checkpoint name; existing plugin names are refused

settings.description: Explicit SDK setting keys from set_develop_settings to capture from the source photo

tools.name: export_develop_preset
tools.title: Export develop preset
tools.description: Copy one exact custom or plugin-managed Develop preset backing file to a destination directory. Provide preset_uuid or preset_name. Existing files are never overwritten; built-in presets without backing files cannot be exported.

filename.description: Optional leaf filename. Extension must match the Lightroom backing file.

tools.name: apply_develop_preset
tools.title: Apply develop preset
tools.description: Apply an exact Develop preset; provide preset_uuid or preset_name. Returns success, applied, resolved preset identity, missing IDs, ai_updated and ai_update_failed. AI masks recompute per target on LrC 13.3+; earlier versions or non-AI presets apply normally. message holds AI warnings only.

dry_run.description: Preview without writes or AI recomputation. Returns setting_totals across all targets and details for at most 5 targets within a 12,000-character detail budget; detail_truncated marks omitted detail. Missing path detail has a 4,000-character budget and is trimmed further to keep the reply within 20,000 characters: missing_count and one-based missing_indices identify all missing inputs, and missing_truncated flags an incomplete missing list. Tables are summarized by entry count and strings over 128 characters by length and prefix. Preset previews compare only declared settings whose current values the SDK exposes. preview_scope is readable_declared_preset_settings; unknown_current_totals counts unreadable values per key, which are excluded from changes and setting_totals. unknown_effects explicitly excludes SDK-generated values including GrainSeed and preset bookkeeping. These effects are not predicted.

photo_ids.description: Array of photo IDs or file paths

tools.name: copy_develop_settings
tools.title: Copy develop settings
tools.description: Copy Develop settings; omitted settings includes AI masks. LrC 13.3+ recomputes each AI mask per target; earlier versions and non-AI copies behave normally. Returns success, copied, missing IDs, ai_updated count, ai_update_failed IDs and AI warning message only.

dry_run.description: Preview without writes or AI recomputation. Returns setting_totals across all targets and details for at most 5 targets within a 12,000-character detail budget; detail_truncated marks omitted detail. Missing path detail has a 4,000-character budget and is trimmed further to keep the reply within 20,000 characters: missing_count and one-based missing_indices identify all missing inputs, and missing_truncated flags an incomplete missing list. Tables are summarized by entry count and strings over 128 characters by length and prefix.

source_id.description: Source photo ID or file path

target_ids.description: Target photo IDs or file paths

settings.description: Optional whitelist of SDK setting keys from set_develop_settings. Omit to copy all.

tools.name: match_photo_style
tools.title: Match reference photo style
tools.description: Apply allowlisted reference global tone/color/curves/detail/noise/grain/vignette after confirming a Develop snapshot per target. Excludes crop, perspective, WhiteBalance/Temperature/Tint, lens corrections and local adjustments/AI masks. Reference cannot be a target, including path aliases. No pixel adaptation. Results: photo_id, snapshot id/name, settings_changed (differing keys); failures have reasons; missing IDs listed. Restore with apply_develop_snapshot.

reference_id.description: Reference photo ID or file path

target_ids.description: Target photo IDs or file paths

tools.name: set_develop_settings
tools.title: Set develop settings
tools.description: Set Develop settings directly on a photo. Keys use allowlisted Lightroom SDK names (Exposure2012, WhiteBalance, Contrast2012, Highlights2012, Shadows2012, Whites2012, Blacks2012, Clarity2012, Vibrance, Saturation, HueAdjustmentRed, SaturationAdjustmentOrange, LuminanceAdjustmentYellow, etc.), plus RGB composite and per-channel point curves via ToneCurvePV2012, ToneCurvePV2012Red, ToneCurvePV2012Green, and ToneCurvePV2012Blue.

oneOf.description: Flat input/output pairs for a Lightroom point curve, e.g. [0, 0, 64, 48, 192, 210, 255, 255]. Values are integers from 0 to 255 and the array holds 2 to 32 pairs, so its length is always even. Inputs must be strictly increasing and the curve must start at input 0 and end at input 255.

tools.name: get_lens_blur
tools.title: Get Lens Blur
tools.description: Read Lens Blur active/amount/cat_eye/highlights_boost/focal_range near/far/focal_range_raw (four SDK values)/bokeh (LrC 13.3+, Process Version 3+). No computed blur returns active:false and unavailable controls. Opens Develop; shared restoration rules apply.

tools.name: set_lens_blur
tools.title: Set Lens Blur
tools.description: Set any subset of Lens Blur active/amount/cat_eye/highlights_boost/focal_range/bokeh (LrC 13.3+, Process Version 3+). Enables first to compute depth; active:false disables after adjustments. Validates runtime numeric ranges before writing. focal_range near/far: 0..100, near<=far; Lightroom supplies outer falloff. Returns readback; unsaved values stop with earlier changes retained. Shared Develop restoration rules apply.

tools.name: set_process_version
tools.title: Set process version
tools.description: Set Version 1–6 (confirm:true; appearance can change). Downgrades with masks are skipped to preserve guarded editing. Opens each in Develop; restore_selection defaults true. Returns previous_version/new_version and changed/unchanged/skipped/failed per photo. Missing/duplicate photos skipped. Max 100; stops near 240 s with remaining_ids to retry.

photo_ids.description: Photo IDs or file paths

restore_selection.description: Restore module, view source and selection (default true)

tools.name: create_virtual_copies
tools.title: Create virtual copies
tools.description: Create one virtual copy per distinct photo (max 25); copy_name optionally names each. Returns copies with photo_id/master_id/copy_id and missing IDs; edit via copy_id. Restores selection/source. Repeats create more; failures can leave earlier copies.

photo_ids.description: Photo IDs or file paths

copy_name.description: Name for each new virtual copy

tools.name: list_develop_snapshots
tools.title: List develop snapshots
tools.description: List a photo develop snapshots with their ids and names.

tools.name: create_develop_snapshot
tools.title: Create develop snapshot
tools.description: Save the current develop settings as a named snapshot. Duplicate names are rejected unless replace is true.

replace.description: Replace the existing snapshot with this name (default false)

tools.name: apply_develop_snapshot
tools.title: Apply develop snapshot
tools.description: Restore a photo develop settings from one of its snapshots.

snapshot_id.description: Snapshot id returned for this photo

tools.name: delete_develop_snapshot
tools.title: Delete develop snapshot
tools.description: Delete one snapshot belonging to the photo.

snapshot_id.description: Snapshot id returned for this photo

tools.name: apply_auto_adjustments
tools.title: Apply auto adjustments
tools.description: Apply Auto Tone, Auto White Balance or both to up to 100 photos. Set tone or white_balance true (omitted=false). Opens each in Develop and waits for settled settings; shared restoration rules apply. Returns applied/unchanged/skipped/failed with non-applied reasons; missing/duplicates skipped. Stops near 240 s with complete:false and remaining_ids to retry.

photo_ids.description: Photo IDs or file paths

white_balance.description: Apply Lightroom Auto White Balance (default false)

tools.name: reset_develop_adjustments
tools.title: Reset develop adjustments
tools.description: Reset all Develop edits, including crop/masks, on up to 100 photos (confirm:true); recover through Lightroom History. Opens each in Develop; shared restoration rules apply. Returns reset/skipped/failed; missing/duplicates skipped. Stops near 240 s or cancellation with remaining_ids to retry.

photo_ids.description: Photo IDs or file paths

tools.name: apply_denoise
tools.title: Apply denoise
tools.description: Enable/change AI Denoise through Develop (LrC 15+), not a develop key. Activates each photo; shared restoration rules apply. Activity Center computes in background. Same amount skips; other settings stay. Max 100 photos; stops near 240 s. Returns success, counts, per-photo results, seconds, complete/remaining_ids and progress/retry guidance.

photo_ids.description: Photo IDs or file paths

amount.description: Denoise amount, as on the Develop panel slider (Lightroom's default is 50)

restore_selection.description: Put the user's module, view source and selection back afterwards (default true). Pass false when calling in back-to-back batches: restoring loads one more photo per call.

tools.name: list_spots
tools.title: List Remove spots
tools.description: List Remove spots (LrC 14.1+): count, 1-based index and complete SDK params including nested fields. Indices shift after deletion. Opens Develop, preserves active tool; shared restoration rules apply.

tools.name: update_spot
tools.title: Update Remove spot opacity
tools.description: Set one Heal spot params.Opacity (uppercase, 0..1) by 1-based list_spots index (LrC 14.1+). Preserves other fields/spots; sends complete selected-spot table and reads back. Returns index/changed/SDK params. Opens Remove if needed; restores previous tool and shared Develop state.

tools.name: delete_spot
tools.title: Delete Remove spot
tools.description: Delete Remove spot by 1-based list_spots index (LrC 14.1+, confirm:true). Returns deleted_index, remaining count/spots; later indices shift. Invalid index fails unchanged. Opens Remove if needed; restores previous tool and shared Develop state.
